name: Area at least 1 hectare
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4(1), definition of forest land, para (a) (area of land of at least 1 hectare)
implementation: Compare unrounded area in EPSG:2193 with 10000 square metres
failure_action: Quarantine and record measured hectares; adjacency is not tested, and MPI excludes small tree areas under 1 hectare only when more than 15 metres from adjacent forest

name: Average width at least 30 metres
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4(1), definition of forest land, para (c)(i)-(ii) (average width of less than 30 metres excluded, unless contiguous with land meeting para (a) or (b)); MPI, Registering areas of forest land less than 30 metres wide on average in the ETS, 10 May 2026, p 1 (method) and p 2 (15 metre adjacency)
implementation: Use -15 m erosion as primary diagnostic and compare with 2A/P; neither is the legal centre-line method
failure_action: Quarantine erosion failures and all method disagreements for assessor measurement; contiguity with qualifying forest land and MPI's 15 metre adjacency route are not tested, so a quarantined unit may still be eligible

name: Not materially mapped as pre-1990 forest land
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4(1), definitions of post-1989 forest land, para (a)(i) (not forest land on 31 December 1989), and pre-1990 forest land, para (a)(i)
implementation: Calculate intersection area and percentage with supplied LUCAS 1989/2007 planted-forest evidence
failure_action: Quarantine when overlap is greater than 1 square metre and at least 1 percent; retain smaller positive overlaps as advisory evidence; require manual land-history review

name: No material supplied public-conservation overlap
source_clause: Project triage policy; ownership and registered rights still require authoritative evidence
implementation: Calculate intersection area and percentage with DOC public-conservation polygons
failure_action: Exclude from this opportunity queue when overlap is greater than 1 square metre and at least 1 percent; retain smaller positive overlaps as advisory evidence

name: Current land-cover proxy is potentially plantable
source_clause: Project proxy based on LCDB class; not an ETS eligibility rule

name: Species qualifies as forest species
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4(1), definition of forest species (excludes tree species grown or managed primarily for fruit or nut crops)

name: Crown cover more than 30 percent in each hectare
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4(1), definition of forest land, para (a) (tree crown cover from forest species of more than 30% in each hectare)
failure_action: Manual evidence and imagery review required

name: Species capable of reaching 5 metres at maturity
source_clause: Climate Change Response Act 2002, s 4(1), definition of forest species (capable of reaching at least 5 metres in height at maturity in the place where it is located)
failure_action: Manual species and site evidence required
